Elise Adams <Elise.M.Adams@stonybrook.edu>:
Hi, I am encountering an issue with my study (4040), specifically with AID 104476 and AID 104560 related to triggering logics, which has led to these participants getting only 3 of 4 survey prompts a day (only on some days). I had originally set the triggering logic up based on a baseline survey where I ask about sleep habits. In one question, I ask about the typical time the ppt goes to bed, and one of the response options was "after 1 AM". I had set it up so that if they say that, their last prompt of the day comes in between 00:00-01:00 the next day (so the prompt was as close to bedtime as possible). So far in the study, the IDs above are the only two that have responded with this answer choice, and I noticed that 104476 has only been receiving 3/4 prompts a day (not the last prompt of the day) every day, and 104560 is scheduled to receive that last prompt only on some days (but not all days). I thought the issue might be that the prompts were scheduled for the next day, so I changed the triggering logic to send their prompts between 23:00 and 23:59 PM the same day, published the changes, and reloaded the devices. Still, it seems their scheduled survey times did not change on Avicenna. Would you be able to provide some guidance on this? It's okay if the prompt timing cannot be restored to the original timing (between 00:00-01:00), but I'm wondering if there's a way to update the timing of prompts for ppts that are already enrolled in the study, since they've just begun and there's still time to get valuable data from them. Thank you, Elise-- Elise (Cummings) Adams, M.A. Ph.D. Candidate Clinical Psychology Stony Brook University Pronouns: She/Her/Hers -- This e-mail message, including any attachments, is for the sole use of the intended recipient(s) and may contain confidential and privileged information. Amin Ghaffari <support@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi EliseI did check the issue and found the root cause.If you switch over to "Week" view in your activity sessions, you can see those "missing" activities. (Please check my attached screenshot for instructions).the issue is caused due to a difference in your participants' timezones and your timezone. So basically, when viewing the activity sessions in Day view, some activities might go beyond 23:59 of that day, hence cannot be displayed on the chart, but when you move to the next day, the session is not displayed again since the date specifically points to the day before, it won't be shown, resulting in missing activities. In week view however, we don't have this issue. The bug is reported to the team and they're currently working on a fix. For now, please make sure you always check the activity sessions in Week view.
